indexes.label: Observed AI use, moving toward what is feasible
indexes.note: Each occupation starts at Anthropic's observed exposure and moves toward its Eloundou et al. exposure; the scenario dials (affected share, diffusion, gain, automation share, new tasks) are those of Korinek, Jones, Sacher, Cotter and McCrory (2026). Automated time removes whole tasks; assisted time is saved on tasks that stay.

indexes.label: Eloundou et al. task labels with assumed adoption
indexes.note: Tasks a language model, alone or with software built on it, could do in half the time or less, removed up to an assumed fraction by type of occupation (35% digital and unlicensed, 7.5% licensed, 12.5% physical), times the dial.

indexes.label: Schaal (2025) task scores with assumed adoption
indexes.note: Task scores from three language models on four task properties, removed up to the same assumed fractions, times the dial.
